events.name: Bash
events.head: Check whether the two commits are already on origin
events.input: $ git fetch -q origin && for c in 6a59a78 5d8a0ca 80878cb; do git merge-base --is-ancestor $c origin/main && echo "$c on origin" || echo "$c NOT on origin"; done; git rev-parse --short origin/main; git rev-list --left-right --count main...origin/main; grep -n "TEAM_INBOX\|adi@growthclub" workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py | head

events.text: Both commits are already on origin, so no cherry-pick or push is needed. Running the checks on origin/main and checking the T-397 reconcile item.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run hand-off test and probe, check lead email default
events.input: $ git show origin/main:workshop-plan/ops/endy_leads.py | grep -c GrowthCluborg; python3 workshop-plan/ops/test_endy_leads.py 2>&1 | tail -2; node cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs 2>&1 | tail -2; grep -rln "adi@growthclub.org" workshop-plan/ops/endy* workshop-plan/ops/launchd/ workshop-plan/ops/runbook.md 2>/dev/null; grep -n "ENDY_LEAD_EMAIL" -A1 workshop-plan/ops/launchd/com.tantra.centre-sheet.plist | head -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Count passing checks
events.input: $ python3 workshop-plan/ops/test_endy_leads.py 2>&1 | grep -c "^ok"; python3 workshop-plan/ops/test_endy_leads.py 2>&1 | grep -ci "fail"; node cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs 2>&1 | grep -c "^ok"; node cloud/scripts/probe-no-instantly-endy.mjs 2>&1 | grep -ci "fail"; grep -rn "instantly" -i cloud/src/agentic.ts cloud/src/jobs.ts | grep -i endy | head -3
